metric: Per case: amountMinor/sign/dateISO are scored on every case; category/payee only when the case's label asserts them (see evals/scoring.py). "overall" spans every case in the dataset — both parse cases (a real expense) and refusal cases (expected: null) — with a refusal case counted correct on a null return; "parseCases"/"failToParse" split that same population back out, and "perAxis" breaks it down further by dataset axis.
command: FM_PROBE_PATH=$PWD/evals/fm/probe node evals/run-eval.mjs --engine=fm --n=2 --split=holdout2 --confirm-holdout --purpose="holdout v2 declared FM baseline before step 2/3 tuning"

rescoredOffline.reason: re-baseline after h2 sign-label schema fix (amendment): re-scored exactly and offline from the existing per-case diagnostics; no FM look spent
rescoredOffline.note: Re-scored OFFLINE from stored per-run parses against the current dataset labels; no model was called and no holdout look was spent.

rawReconstructed.from: evals/results/fm.holdout2.json at commit bde1aeb (per-case sampleDiagnostics.wrongFields / attemptsPerRun)
rawReconstructed.method: FM is deterministic (2/2 or 0/2 per case). A sample has a wrong field exactly when sampleDiagnostics lists it; its parse is the recorded actual for wrong fields and the label value for right ones.
rawReconstructed.lossy: parse values for fields that were right are the labels at reconstruction time, not recorded model output; a future label change to a field that was right here cannot be re-scored exactly from this file.
rawReconstructed.reason: re-baseline after h2 sign-label schema fix (amendment)

relativeToByok.referenceNote: ONE named reference engine (not best-per-metric). Measured on the same split at N>=3; per-run mean of each metric.
relativeToByok.refusal: absolute only: targets.refusal (0.95) plus a per-subtype report. Never compared to the max over engines or to BYOK.

excludeFromByokRelative.until: the 2026-10-01 product decision (questions, budgets, plans, IOUs are refused) is encoded in every engine's prompt
excludeFromByokRelative.reason: today no engine prompt encodes the refuse rule, so a finance-near-miss comparison measures prompt wording, not model quality

estimators.parse: pass-rate: share of parse cases reliable (per-case pass-rate >= perCase 0.6)
estimators.refusal: pass-rate: share of refusal cases reliable (per-case pass-rate >= perCase 0.6)
estimators.others: per-run value, reported as mean over the N runs with min-max (ledgerCorrect, recall, strata, refusal subtypes, vocabulary groups, field accuracy)

extendedMetricsEstimator: run-0 (first run only): counts and per-axis detail; see perRunMetrics for mean and min-max over all runs
